provenance.notes: A starting point, nothing read yet: read __Title__'s terms and usage policy at their source, then fill this file in and set verifiedAt to that day - rateLimits (null while unknown, [] when the terms set none; a window of several units with "every", a quota counted in characters, units or points with "unit" and each operation's "cost"), concurrency, the rights (unknown stays unknown: a site cannot turn it into allowed), what a request must carry (a key, a User-Agent), the terms' address. omnisense/contracts' docs/declare-your-policy.md says how.
